canonical_selection_evidence.interpretation: This bundle is the only v2 bundle whose companion log records a completed epoch-1 validation, a best_model.pt save, and the pt_graph_sort_avg_pool run path. The publication archive's pretrain configuration loads pt_graph_sort_avg_pool_e1 and declares the final 1.2k architecture. The weight still requires safe state-dict inspection before admission.

embedding_contract.forbidden_postprocessing: The released cell-embedding script calls refine_embedding with true cell-type labels for every evaluated cell, aligns batch-by-cell-type means, and amplifies class separation. This is target leakage and is prohibited in every benchmark lane.
embedding_contract.native_lane_rule: Native evaluation starts from the unrefined encoder embedding. Any supervised correction must be learned from outer-training donors only and applied without evaluation labels as a separately named adaptation run.
embedding_contract.row_identity_rule: Carry immutable input row IDs through batching and join outputs by row ID, never generated observation names or output order.

input_contract.sampling_warning: The released dataset code randomly subsamples expressed genes when a cell exceeds max_seq_len. The common lane derives the sampling seed from the immutable row ID and must pass cell-order invariance.

noncanonical_artifacts.name: best_model.pt
noncanonical_artifacts.reason: Its companion all-length log concatenates failed, resumed, and incomplete runs, ends partway through epoch 1, and does not identify which produced object was uploaded. The publication tutorial points to an all-length path, but no released args.json binds this file to a reproducible architecture or terminal checkpoint.

noncanonical_artifacts.name: best_model.pt
noncanonical_artifacts.reason: The v1 object has an args.json but represents the earlier 22-million-cell/preprint configuration rather than the final RegFormer-1.2k publication model.

publication_archive.repository_mirror_rule: The pinned GitHub revision is the last revision before the v3 archive date and its audited publication files are byte-identical by MD5 to the v3 Figshare copies.

runtime_contract.warning: The declared Torch CUDA 11.6 and DGL CUDA 11.8 builds are internally mismatched and old compiled Mamba/FlashAttention extensions require isolated L40S compatibility probes before any checkpoint load.

source_evidence: The Nature Communications article, bioRxiv v1, Figshare versions 1-3 and their file APIs, the publication archive, and the pinned byte-identical GitHub mirror were queried on 2026-08-22. Checkpoint tails were range-inspected only; no complete checkpoint was downloaded or deserialized.
